dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, that thing over there looks super intimidating. You sure it's not gonna fall off?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Hahaha, don't worry! Our tribe works closely with stone. That's one of our symbols, actually.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: It's not going anywhere, I promise you!
